Aricchit
son of Pravarasena, a Dramiḍa prince, son of king Dramiḍa.
--C. Sudhāvidyotinī on Saundaryalaharī. which is ascribed to king Pravarasena, the father of the commentator. MD. 10876. Śg. I. p.. 132-35. TCD. 293F.
Usually the hymn Saundaryalaharī is ascribed to Śaṅkarācārya; in MD. 10874, Diṇḍima Rāma in his C. records traditions ascribing it to Śiva Himself an. Devī Herself, besides Śaṅkarācārya.
In this C. Sudhāvidyotinī, however, we are given a new story. In the Tamil country there was a. prince of the royal house called Pravarasena, who had been blessed by Devī with her own breast-milk an. who composed this hymn in a forest where his father, [Page370-a. king Dramiḍa had abandoned him soon after his birth owing to some bad combination of planets in his horoscope. This Pravarasena, in previous birth, had been a Brahman on the banks of the Ganges, worshipping Kāmarāja. He was subsequently brought to the capital; to him an. queen Rūpavatī was born Aricchit who wrote his gloss on his father's hymn.
In this connection it may be pointed out that the hymn itself refers to the story of a.“Dramiḍa śiśu” being given milk by the Goddess, a. allusion which is usually taken to refer to the Tamil hymnist Jñānasambandhar.

Arimalla
or Malladeva.
--Tṛtīyajvarāṣṭaka. BORI. D. XIX. i. 242.

Ariyavaṃsa
Bud. Pāli. writer of Pagan, of the Chapaṭa sect.; 15th Cent. A. D.
--Ganthābharaṇa. Pāli. gr.
Pt.. in a collection. Rangoon, 1905. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 53-4. 575.
--Jātakaviśodhana. on the Jātakas.
--Maṇidīpa, a C. on the Atthasālinī on Dhammasaṅgaṇi of the Abhidammapiṭaka.
--Maṇisāramañjūṣā, a C. on Abhidhammattha vibhāvani. Colombo D. I. 691.
See also Bode, Pāli. Lit. Burma, p. 41 ff.
Pt.. Rangoon, 1905. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 77-8. [Page370-b]

Ariyavaṃsa
Bud. Pāli. a compilation, probably of life histories of eminent Buddhists made in Ceylon, intended to be read out to gatherings. Mahāvaṁsa xxxvi. 38. transl. 258, n. 6.

Ariyavaṃsālaṅkāra
Bud. Pāli. by Nāṇābhisāsanadhaja Mahādhammarājaguru of Burma, Sāsanavaṁsa p.. 134. 135.

Ariyasaccāvatāra
Bud. Pāli. mentioned in a list of works in a. inscription of 1442 A. D. a. Pagan. See Bode, Pāli Lit. Burma p. 107.

Ariyālaṅkāra
the younger, pupil of Ariyālaṁkāra.
--C. Sārattavikāsinī on Kaccāyanabheda. Fausbo7ll 154. See Bode, Pāli Lit. Burma, p. 55. Sāsanavaṁsa p.. 106-12.

Ariṣṭadhīmat
Bud.
--Śrī Cakra śambarodaya nāma maṇḍalopāyikā. Cordier II. p. 54.

Ariṣṭanavanīta
sometimes called navanItAriSTa jy. in 6 chs. by Navanītanartana Kavi. Alwar 1711. Extr. 452. B. IV. 114. MD. 13604-6. 17374. Mithilā. Mithilā III. 9. 9 (A-D.. Mysore I. p.. 327 (3 mss.). 647. Nepal I. p. 148. NP. XI. 46. Oppert II. 4468. PUL. II. p. 210. Rice 28. 32. Śṛṅgerī 42. TD. 11306-8. XX. Sup. no. 1004 (fr.).
--C. Śrīdharā by Śrīdhara; q. Vaijayantīkośa, Vāgbhaṭa, Devakīrti an. Devala. Alwar 1711. Extr. 452. America 4723a. IM. 1026. MD. 13607. Mysore I. p.. 327. 647. Nepal I. p. 148. Rice 32. Śṛṅgerī 42. [Page371-a.

Ariṣṭanemicarita
Jain. by Ratnaprabhasūri. See Nemināthacarita.
--by Śrīvijayagaṇi. H. 410 (Vijayaº). Oxf. II. 1401 (p. 237b).

Ariṣṭavadhādicarita
by Rūpagosvāmin. RASB. VII. 5562 (6-P) (from Stavamālā).
Pt.. Stavamālā, K. M. 84, p.. 222-26.

Ariṣṭaśānti
dh.-jy. Mithilā. MT. 746 (e) (C.. Sarvāriṣṭaśānti, MD. 3461).

Ariṣṭasaṃhitā
jy. Q. in Ariṣṭalakṣaṇa, MD. 13608.

Ariṣṭasthāna
vaidya. by Vararuci (?) Filliozat 1. ibid. C.. 74a. See below Aṣṭakarmādhikārasthāna.

Ariṣṭādhyāya
jy. BISM. v.. 366/7.
--by Maheśa. Mithilā III. 11 forms ch. 10 of the Jyotirmahānibandha caused to be compiled by Raṇavīrasiṁha of Kashmir.

Ariṣṭādhyāya
Jain. Pkt. Arrah I. p. 41. Pannalal Bombay 223. Pannalal Bombay IV. p. 1.

Arisiṃha
Jain. Śvet. son of Lāvaṇya or Lavaṇasiṁha, contemporary of Vastupāla (1242 A. D.), the Jain minister of the Rāṇa of Dholkā, Vīradhavala an. of Viśaladeva, son of Vīradhavala; perhaps [Page371-b] also guru of Amaracandra; see above under Amaracandra. Arasī Ṭhakkura is probably same.
--wrote part of Amaracandra's Kāvyakalpalatā. Chowk. edn. See also NCC. IV. p. 85.
--Sukṛtasaṅkīrtana, mahākāvya on his patron, Vastupāla, where Amaracandra add. a postscript to each canto (11 cantos). BBRAS. 1786. Bombay 1879-82. p. 8. D. p. 194.
See Ind. Ant. 31. p.. 477-495.
Pt.. Jaina Ātmānanda Sabhā Series 51, Bhavnagar, 1917.
See also Oxf. 210b. BP. p. 6.

Arisiṃha_Kavi
mentioned a. Āsaḍa's son by the second wife in Bālacandra's gloss (1275 A. D.) on Āsaḍa's Vivekamañjarī. Peters. III. Extr. p. 102. verse 11.

Arihantakevalin
Jain work in Skt. BORI. 1080 of 1887-91.

Arihantavinati
BORI. D. XVII. iii. 711 (see no. 30 of the other works in the codex).

Āriṣasaṅgraha_(?)
Jain. on pūjā etc. of Jain images, in 40 chs. Taylor I. 390.
